title: H2 Hardened machinery: fail-closed guards and self-healing health
description: Context: a 2h47m dabble-employee-app agent session made 300 CLI calls with 24 failures. Failure clusters: 117 read-only work show polls (~40% of all calls), 14 identical failed sync refresh retries, 6 vault init retries, 66 agent finish calls with only 2 standalone evidence records, 6 NOT_FOUND finish/release (ownership confusion), 1 CONFLICT claim, 2 POLICY_VIOLATION sprint closes. Design principle for this mission: every response (success or error) must carry enough state that the correct next action is derivable without another read, and the honest path (evidence, ownership, health) must be the path of least resistance. This sprint wires existing enforcement-gap codes (packages/core/src/enforcement-gaps.ts) to actual fail-closed behavior: infra retry loops short-circuit into doctor recovery, the search index heals itself, evidence becomes automatic at finish time and required at close time, and doctor detects stale reservations and git-vs-tracker drift. Depends conceptually on H1 error shapes but each task is independently mergeable.
acceptanceCriteria: Every task closed with test evidence and a commit SHA
Each new guard emits an existing or newly-registered enforcement-gap code, no ad-hoc error strings
closedReason: Sprint scope completed for runtime hardening milestone.
